title: REGARD: Regional Affective Differences in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Querying 19 language models with 500 post-Soviet/CIS-specific targets (e.g., countries, historical events) and evaluating the responses using target-directed Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) profiling via independent LLM judges to detect framing differences based on model origin.
Measuring the emotional intensity and affective framing (VAD scores) of model generations when prompted to describe regional cultural symbols, traditions, and UNESCO-listed heritage sites.

Assessing the affective stance (valence, arousal, dominance) of generated texts regarding politically salient figures, organizations, and contested historical/geopolitical events (e.g., the 2008 Georgia war, Ukraine conflict).
